compare_rates.description: See how far a rate has moved between two dates, as a percentage and as a number. The step to put in front of a condition: alert when a currency has moved more than two per cent since a deal was quoted, or since the start of the quarter. No API key required.

convert_amount.description: Convert an amount of money from one currency to another at the European Central Bank's official reference rate - the rate tax authorities, auditors and contracts cite. Use the latest published rate, or the one in force on a date you name, which is what an invoice or an expense claim needs. Works between any two of the currencies the ECB publishes, not just to and from the euro. No API key required.

No API key required.

get_average_rate.description: Get the ECB's own published average rate for a calendar month, quarter or year - the figure month-end bookkeeping, revaluation and tax filings are done at. Pick any date inside the period you want and the step works out which period that is. The ECB publishes a period's average once the period has ended, so this defaults to the last completed one. No API key required.

get_rate_history.description: Get a rate between two currencies across a stretch of time - for a chart, a trend, or a loop over each day. Choose the daily published rate or the ECB's monthly, quarterly or yearly averages. Comes back with the high, the low and the average over the range as well as the rates themselves. With no dates filled in it covers roughly the last month of daily rates, and the range it used is always reported back. No API key required.

description: Official euro foreign exchange reference rates, straight from the European Central Bank - the rates tax authorities, auditors and contracts cite. Convert an amount between any two of the currencies the ECB tracks, look up a rate for today or for the day an invoice was raised, pull the whole daily table, chart a rate over time, and read the ECB's own monthly, quarterly and yearly averages for month-end bookkeeping. Rates go back to 1999. No account or API key required.
